_source: Extracted from AMB's written deliverables and PDF exhibit packs: AMB + Topkey Pre-LOI Deal Memo.docx, Topkey - Keystone Acquisition Opportunity Report v3.docx, AMB + Sunshine Commercial - Deal Memo.docx, AMB Advisory + Sunshine Commercial - Initial CRE Valuation.docx, Keystone Pre-LOI Diligence / Initial P&L Overview / Customer Retention / Offer Scenario PDFs, Sunshine Commercial diligence report PDFs. See docs/research/amb-deliverables.md. 'observed' = what AMB does today; 'recommended' = proposed standard for the bot's CIM and memos.

crimsonBand.use: Word header band (full-bleed image, ~0.75in tall), cover bars on PDF exhibit packs (renders as #9A0033), table header fill in the Opportunity Report, left rule on callouts

maroonHeading.use: All Word headings (H1/H2/Quick Stats), callout lead-ins ('Takeaway:'), numbered-list numerals

maroonTableHeader.use: Exhibit table header rows and single-series bar fills in the Excel-exported PDFs (7A0000 and 7B0000 both occur)

sectionBandPink.use: Section label rows inside exhibit tables ('Revenue', 'Expenses', 'P&L Adjustments')

totalRowYellow.use: Key total rows, boxed with a thin black border per column group

calloutFill.use: Takeaway / Opportunity / Long-term view callouts (with 3pt 990033 left border)

subtotalRowTint.use: Bold subtotal rows in Word bridge tables

considerationsHeader.use: Header of the 'Priority P&L Considerations' table in the Topkey memo (observed only; off-palette)

creSensitivityBlue.use: Axis headers of Sunshine sensitivity grids (observed only; off-palette)

creSectionGrey.use: Section title bars on Sunshine exhibits (observed only)

passGreen.use: Cells that clear a threshold in sensitivity grids

flagRed.use: Thin outline boxes around the base-case or key cells in sensitivity grids and pro forma columns

recommendedChartPalette.note: Keep the maroon anchor, drop Excel defaults (70AD47 green, 00B0F0 cyan, FF0000 red). One accent, greys for context.

observed.body: Times New Roman 11.5pt (Opportunity Report docDefaults sz=23) or 12pt (Topkey memo); line 1.1 (264/240), 6pt after
observed.h1: Times New Roman 17pt bold 7B0000, 15pt before / 6pt after, keepNext (Opportunity Report); 16pt bold 7B0000 (Topkey memo)
observed.h2: Times New Roman 12.5pt bold 7B0000, 10pt before / 4pt after
observed.exhibitTitle: Times New Roman 12pt bold 7B0000 (e.g. 'Monthly STR Subscription Revenue (Jan'24 - July'26)')
observed.documentTitle: Times New Roman 20pt bold 7B0000 + subtitle 14pt italic black
observed.tableText: Times New Roman 10pt; header bold white on 990033
observed.footnote: Times New Roman 10pt, '(1) ...' numbering, or italic 10pt 'Note: ...'
observed.headerBandText: Times New Roman 15-16pt bold white, centred, on the 990033 band with the white AMB logo at right

observed.pageSubtitle: Arial 9pt italic, '<Exhibit name> ($000s)', followed by a thin black rule across the print width
observed.tableHeader: Arial 9pt bold white on 7A0000; two-tier (period group centred over period labels)
observed.tableBody: Arial 8.5-9pt (P&L), down to 5.9pt on 18-column retention tables (too small)
observed.chartTitle: Arial 8.5-9pt bold, sometimes underlined, left-aligned above the plot
observed.coverTitle: Arial 21pt bold / subtitle 16pt bold italic / 'As of MM/DD/YY' 14.7pt italic

recommended.cimBodyFont: Keep Times New Roman for prose if the owner wants continuity with AMB memos, or move prose to a serif such as Georgia/Cambria; keep Arial for all numbers, tables and charts (AMB's exhibit convention).
recommended.actionTitle: Sentence-case headline stating the conclusion, 16-18pt bold 7B0000, one line, above every CIM page

numberConventions.units: State units once in the exhibit subtitle: '($000s)' or '($)'
numberConventions.currency: $ on the first row and on total rows only; body rows plain with thousands separators
numberConventions.negatives: Parentheses in tables: (116), ($166); minus sign in prose: '–$166K'
numberConventions.notMeaningful: '--' in the first growth column (observed); recommend 'n.m.'
numberConventions.percent: 0 dp for mix/growth/deltas (23%, (88%)); 1 dp for margins (12.8%)
numberConventions.periods: FY2024/FY2025, YTD July'25 / July'26, LTM July'26, PF July'26; months as Jan-25 in tables, Jan'24 in titles

layouts.wordPage: US Letter portrait, 1in margins (Topkey memo) or T1.11/B0.90/L1.0/R1.0in (Opportunity Report)
layouts.exhibitPage: US Letter landscape 11x8.5in for Keystone packs; portrait for Sunshine packs
layouts.cover: Two 990033 bars (~11pt) near top and bottom, each paired with a 1.4pt black rule; target logo centred; thin rules above and below the title block; AMB logo bottom-right (or AMB logo centred when no target logo)
layouts.callout: Paragraph with 3pt 990033 left border, F7EBEF fill, bold 7B0000 lead-in ('Takeaway:', 'Opportunity:', 'Long-term view:') then black text
